questions.prompt: By the time the committee met, the pilot study ______ for six months.
questions.explanation: “By the time”引导的从句用一般过去时，主句动作发生在之前，用过去完成时。
questions.evidence: By the time the committee met, the pilot study had run for six months.

questions.prompt: The report ______ the council read was written by the manufacturer.
questions.explanation: 定语从句修饰物，用that或which，这里用that。
questions.evidence: The report that the council read was written by the manufacturer.

questions.prompt: 选择首次介绍职业、泛指“一名工程师”而非特指已知人物的冠词：She is ______ engineer.
questions.explanation: 题目明确泛指首次介绍的职业，用不定冠词；engineer以元音音素开头，因此an。the可用于特指已知工程师，但不符合这里明确的泛指意义。

questions.prompt: There isn't ______ water left in the tank.
questions.evidence: There isn't much water left in the tank.

questions.prompt: The number of participants ______ increased since last year.
questions.explanation: 主语是the number，谓语用单数has。
questions.evidence: The number of participants has increased since last year.

questions.prompt: The organisers did not consult the forecast before yesterday's event. Complete the past counterfactual: If the organisers ______ the forecast, they would have moved the picnic indoors.
questions.explanation: 题目给出已结束的过去事实，要求过去反事实条件句，因此用had considered，与would have moved呼应。这是独立语法情境，不声称源文议会忽视了已掌握的证据。
questions.evidence: If the organisers had considered the forecast, they would have moved the picnic indoors.

questions.prompt: The volunteers ______ joined the workshop received a certificate.
questions.explanation: volunteers指人，空格在关系从句中作主语，选who。whom作宾语，whose表示所属；此句是独立语法情境，不给原试点添加相反的节水结果。
questions.evidence: The volunteers who joined the workshop received a certificate.

questions.prompt: Each of the households ______ a different result every month.
questions.explanation: every month指重复情况，主语中心词each要求单数一般现在时shows。不能被介词of后面的复数households干扰而选择复数谓语。
questions.evidence: Each of the households shows a different result every month.

title: How Evidence Changed a Public Recommendation · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
本课重点复习五个语法点：1) 时态：根据时间状语选择一般过去时、现在完成时等。2) 从句：宾语从句、定语从句等要注意连接词和语序。3) 冠词：a/an 用于泛指，the 用于特指。4) 数量：可数名词用 many/few，不可数名词用 much/little。5) 主谓一致：主语和谓语在人称和数上要一致。下面8道题针对这些点，请选择或填空。 复习过去完成时had + 过去分词表达过去某时点之前的经历。第三条件句用if + had done、主句would have done表达对已结束过去的相反假设；这与第一、第二条件句不同。Each of + 复数名词作主语时，谓语按each使用单数形式；一般过去时规则动词本身通常不显示单复数区别。

The council voted to adopt the new recommendation.
